Players Committee card image of [[Anakin Skywalker (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If I Feel The Conflict on table: USED: ▲ a Death Star II site. OR Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. LOST: During battle at a site, if Luke armed with [Death Star II] Luke's Lightsaber, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.
